layout.description: Chinese supports landscape or portrait. English portrait supports B1–B4; English landscape retains all current groups.

media.description: Global presenter, voice and music bindings are always explicit. Additional scene-specific visual roles retain their existing catalog.mediaPorts contracts. Read MEDIA.md for official music-prepare result mapping.

file.description: Existing local file. Absolute path or path relative to user.json; relative paths stay inside that input directory. Follow the verified personal helper input-vault rules.

discardPresenterAudio.description: True only when the user requests muting embedded presenter sound.

voice.description: presenter preserves embedded sound from media.presenter.mode=video. file supplies a separate complete narration track. none requires discardPresenterAudio=true when the supplied presenter video has sound; never set it automatically. Bound voice duration matches the whole scene plan within 0.05 seconds.

face.description: Optional normalized original-frame face hint. If absent, the existing approximate local detector runs.

items.description: Existing output-clock tracking hint; entries sorted by time and within film duration.

presenter.description: none is an explicit no-presenter choice. image uses PNG/JPEG/WebP. video must cover the full output clock. No avatar-generation mode is implemented.

file.description: Existing local file. Absolute path or path relative to user.json; relative paths stay inside that input directory. Follow the verified personal helper input-vault rules.

license.description: Required nonempty rights evidence for file mode. Pass the actual music-prepare result.license object unchanged, or actual user-supplied license text/object. It is retained as provenance, not interpreted as a mix control.

music.description: Bind music-prepare result.output as file and result.license as license. The local file must contain nonzero audio and cover the complete output duration. none is explicit no-score. This adapter has no per-track gain, offset, start, looping or generate mode; prepare a duration-matched file first. Existing extra provenance metadata remains compatible.

units.description: Nonempty units require actual narrationTimingEvidence; never subdivide a sentence to fabricate word times.

wordIndices.description: Contiguous actual raw word indices; exact text/first-last boundaries checked against retained evidence, never inferred.

narrationMap.description: Complete shot ownership. Sentence beats use complete owned cue text and unchanged cue intervals. measured-word requires actual narrationTimingEvidence and wordIndices; see NARRATION-MAP.md.

wordIndices.description: Contiguous actual raw word indices; exact text/first-last boundaries checked against retained evidence, never inferred.

purpose.description: Actual visual meaning, not a free-form label. Scene-specific restrictions and stamp/check/checklist rules remain mandatory; see NARRATION-MAP.md.

narrationTimingEvidence.description: Real word ASR/forced-align result for measured-word beats or caption units. See NARRATION-MAP.md; file hashes and declared tools provide provenance, not semantic acceptance.

offsetSeconds.description: Measured output = raw word seconds + offsetSeconds; no rate change. Nonzero offset requires source-media-seconds.

captionTimingEvidence.description: Actual listened-to complete SRT or local ASR/alignment source; provided-captions is not proof. Read NARRATION-MAP.md.

narrationVisualMode.description: Optional measured-sentence reveal for B1–B4. Omitted keeps the approved original choreography; no guessed word clocks.

narrationLayout.description: Optional new-production portrait centering for no-presenter B1/B2/B4. Omitted retains approved placement and all source clocks.

creationProfile.description: New narrated input; compile actual caption references and opt in to current sentence visuals. Omit to retain an old input.

captionPosition.description: Optional portrait publish-preview ratios, chosen by the assistant after viewing the intended interface. Defaults bottom .24, left .08, right .16. Editorial preset, not an official device/platform guarantee.

captionSafeArea.description: Portrait uses an editorial bottom/right UI reserve. frame retains previous positioning for explicit legacy replay. Landscape defaults are unchanged.

portraitComposition.description: New supplied-presenter B1-B4 portrait arrangement: upper content, original-size centered presenter, full short-video caption checks. legacy explicitly replays the previous right/lower mapping. Other native groups and landscape retain their geometry.
